desc: Have you wanted to mount a camera, a bipod and a light to your favorite M-LOK equipped hog hunting or predator rifle? Now you can! Get the ODIN Works M-LOK to ARCA 3 Way Rail added to your AR style rifle's M-LOK handguard. ODIN Works' 3 Way Multi Rail is the adapter you've been looking for. Compatible with M-LOK mounting systems, it gives you the ability to add ARCA, Harris or picatinny equipped accessories to your rifle on an incredibly stable platform. The strong lightweight 6061-T6 aluminum construction and black hardcoat anodized finish will last a lifetime. Bi-Pods, Tri-Pods, lights and lasers, ODIN Works gives you rock solid stability on the M-LOK to ARCA 3 Way Rail.
